title: Integrate eval-gated quality checks into canary and A/B rollout pipelines
creator: Priya Sharma
description: Add a gating layer to canary rollouts, A/B tests and shadow traffic routes that automatically evaluates candidate model variants against curated eval prompt sets (golden datasets). If the scorecard for a candidate drops below configurable thresholds on key metrics (e.g., factuality, toxicity, length drift, hallucination rate), the rollout is paused and either auto-rolled back or flagged for manual review. This ticket implements the engineering plumbing, API hooks, and CI checks required to run evals as part of automated rollouts and ship a minimal runtime integration to Redwood Console for visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Canary deployment pipeline runs an eval job against the selected golden prompt set before increasing traffic to 10% (smoke) and again at 50% (pre-main).
Scorecards produced by the eval job are stored in S3 and mapped to the canary instance ID and rollout ID.
A configurable gating rule engine evaluates scorecards and blocks progress when thresholds are violated.
Auto-rollback API is callable by the rollout controller and will revert routing within 90s of a gate failure.
Redwood Console shows per-rollout scorecards, pass/fail status, and links to failing examples.
End-to-end tests that simulate a regression (synthetic golden prompts) cause the pipeline to block and trigger rollback in CI.
Documentation and runbook for on-call to inspect gated failures and override rollouts with audit logging.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Server-side eval runner service that can fetch model snapshot and run golden prompt sets in parallel (branch deployment).
Phase 2: Integrate eval runner into canary controller; require eval pass to move from 0->10% and 10->50% traffic steps.
Phase 3: Hook into A/B experiment scheduler to compute per-variant scorecards and support post-hoc gating for long-running experiments.
Phase 4: Add shadow traffic mode where evals run on 100% of examples for passive monitoring without affecting user traffic.
Phase 5: Ship Console UI panel with historical scorecards, failing example golden prompts, and rollback controls.
rollback_criteria: Any primary metric on the scorecard (configurable list: factuality_score, coherence_score, toxicity_rate) decreases by >5 absolute points compared to baseline.
Hallucination rate increases by more than 30% relative to baseline over the last 1k eval samples.
A single catastrophic failure pattern detected by detectors (e.g., PII leakage) marked as 'block'.
Evaluation runner fails to complete within the rollout window (timeout).
golden_prompt_sets: core_qa_v3 (500 prompts, curated factual Q/A across domains)
safety_smoke_v2 (200 prompts targeting toxicity and PII scenarios)
customer_specific_gate_A (100 prompts supplied by enterprise customers with redaction enabled)
tests: e2e/simulated_regression: deploy variant that intentionally degrades factuality -> pipeline should block and auto-rollback.
integration/timeout_handling: eval runner times out -> rollout should pause and create incident ticket.
integration/storage_mapping: scorecards saved and retrievable by rollout ID.
unit/gate_rules: threshold expressions compiles and evaluates for rule permutations.
smoke/canary_latency: ensure eval runs add less than 2s median overhead to canary orchestration.

notes: Design trade-off: running full eval before any traffic slows rollout; solution uses a small smoke subset for early gating and full evaluation at later step.
We will reuse existing eval metrics pipeline from 'optimize-evals' to avoid duplicating detectors.
Auto-rollback will invoke the same route update path used by runtime emergency rollback to maintain audit trails.
Operator override requires 2 approvers and will be recorded in audit logs for compliance.
